AbstractText.Label: OBJECTIVE
AbstractText.content: To determine the polymorphisms in the 3' untranslated region (3'UTR) of the G6PD gene and analyze the specific SNPs or haplotypes that may affect messenger RNA (mRNA) secondary structure by in silico analysis.

AbstractText.Label: METHODS
AbstractText.content: We studied the 3'UTR polymorphisms in 107 healthy subjects living in Thailand (ethnicities unknown). The haplotype was analyzed using Haploview software. mRNA secondary structure and microRNA binding of the G6PD gene were predicted by use of the CLC Main Workbench 6.9 and RegRNA 2.0 programs.

AbstractText.Label: RESULTS
AbstractText.content: The results revealed 1 new variant in the 3'UTR of the G6PD gene (c.*99A > G). Haplotype ATCG showed significance by association-test results that yielded a high odds ratio (OR, 7.90; 95% confidence interval [CI], 3.15-19.81). Moreover, this haplotype affected G6PD mRNA secondary structure changes and microRNA binding via in silico analysis.

AbstractText.Label: CONCLUSIONS
AbstractText.content: These results suggest that the haplotype ATCG is associated with reduction of G6PD enzyme expression, G6PD mRNA secondary structure changes, and microRNA binding via in silico analysis.
